Evidence: Karnataka COVID-19 War Room chief Munish Moudgil stated that unvaccinated individuals are 30 times more likely to land in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) compared to vaccinated individuals. This conclusion was drawn from an analysis of COVID-19 infections from January 1 to 7, 2022. Moudgil also noted that unvaccinated people are 10 times more likely to have manifested COVID infection than vaccinated individuals. He explained that, ideally, with 97% of citizens vaccinated, the proportion of COVID cases should reflect this, but unvaccinated individuals constituted a significantly higher percentage of ICU admissions.
Justification: The retrieved evidence directly supports the claim that unvaccinated individuals are 30 times more prone to land in the ICU than vaccinated individuals, as stated by Karnataka official Munish Moudgil. The evidence explicitly mentions this statistic and provides context regarding the analysis conducted on COVID-19 infections, confirming the claim's core assertion. Therefore, the conclusion is drawn from the retrieved evidence, which clearly corroborates the claim.
